task: At least 7 missing requirements in the authentication spec that would cause vulnerabilities or bugs.

criteria.text: At least 7 distinct missing requirements, each a real gap in the given spec (not a restatement of it).
Covers the token lifecycle: JWT expiry and refresh, and revocation or logout (a stolen or old token stays valid otherwise).
Covers credential attacks: rate limiting, lockout or backoff for login attempts.
Covers password storage and policy: hashing with a slow salted algorithm (bcrypt, scrypt or argon2), minimum strength.

Covers at least two of: email verification and uniqueness (including case-insensitive matching); password reset flow; how admins are created or assigned (privilege escalation); authorization checks on profile IDs (IDOR); deactivated or deleted users with valid tokens; JWT algorithm and secret handling; user enumeration through error messages; HTTPS/transport.
